zh.label: 最新版本
zh.title: 截图与贴图支持直接选择文字
changes: 在截图选区和贴图中使用本机 Live Text 选择文字；拖动空白区域仍可移动，边缘把手仍可调整大小
贴图支持复制已选文字；未选择文字时保留复制图片操作，放大时移动把手仅在靠近顶部时显示
官网新增功能、使用场景和产品对比页面，并完善站点地图与结构化信息
官网默认启用基础访问统计，并提供可持久关闭的选项；应用内文字识别继续在本机处理
提供 Apple Silicon 与 Intel 通用版本，应用和 DMG 通过 Apple 公证，Sparkle 更新包带有签名

en.label: Latest
en.title: Select text directly in captures and pinned images
changes: Use on-device Live Text to select text in capture selections and pinned images; dragging blank areas and edge resizing remain available.
Copy selected text from a pinned image, or copy the image when no text is selected; the move handle appears only when approached on enlarged pins.
The website adds feature, use-case, and product-comparison pages with improved sitemap and structured data.
The website enables basic visit analytics by default with a persistent opt-out; in-app text recognition remains on-device.
Includes Apple Silicon and Intel support, an Apple-notarized app and DMG, and a signed Sparkle update package.
